v1_history.rule: V1 rows may be used only as derivation/debug history; V2 terminal is computed from V2 proof objects, not by regrading V1 JSON rows.

basis_rule: The obstruction basis itself is copied byte-for-byte from the pre-outcome V1 freeze. No basis element may be added, removed or weakened because of V1 rows or V2 outcomes.

certificate_contract.positive_gap: explicit exact source object plus independently checkable target gap witness
certificate_contract.basis_membership: canonical symmetry transform and explicit basis element mapping, independently verified
certificate_contract.negative_or_universal_row: complete residual enumeration certificate or proof-producing exact solver certificate bound to the row input
certificate_contract.campaign_terminal: computed solely from independently verified certificates and the frozen terminal logic

independence: generator/solver may not be imported by checker A
checker B must independently validate certificate syntax, input binding, symmetry mapping and terminal aggregation
at least one checker should use a structurally different implementation or proof checker where practical
gate_before_census: All mandatory controls must be accepted/rejected as registered by both independent checkers before any V2 full census result is read.
practical_consequence_rule: Only if GLOBAL_OBSTRUCTION_BASIS_PROOF_CARRIED is fixed may a separate outcome-free protocol freeze exhaustive-solver versus obstruction-guided work (states / exact solver calls primary) before measuring it.
